**– APPLICATION OVERVIEW –**

We are going to build an application for golf leagues. This application will allow multiple league setups. It will have a list of users and users can belong to multiple leagues. Leagues will run from a begin date to an end date. Each event will have a selectable format ranging from standard stroke play to unique custom formats as described below. For each event, I want players to input scores for their group and maintain a live leaderboard. Each scorecard will be a little different because the format will dictate custom scoring, tees, etc. I don’t want the players to have understand how to keep score. They’ll just enter their gross score for a hole and the application will know what to do with it.

For golf course, hole, tee, configurations we will be taking advantage of my platform api in another repo. Can you see that? Do you understand it? Thats where i want to maintain course information because its reusable across applications.

Here are some basic attributes of the key components

User \- username, password, first name, last name, display name (defaults to first name plus first letter of last name), Handicap Index, optional profile picture.

League \- start date, end date, entry fee, logo image, name, description, home facility id (from platform api). Note the some leagues can just recycle from one year to the next. So the image, name, etc. may not change. Just new dates for the current season. Leagues have many seasons, seasons have many events, events have one to many rounds.

Event \- has a format, it has a course configuration id (from platform api), entry fee, date(s) support multi-day tournaments.

**– INFRASTRUCTURE OVERVIEW –**

This application will follow the established pattern of lambda/api gateway cdk project for hosting the backend api. The frontend will be an angular application structured the same way as my other repos.

**– IMPORTANT USER EXPERIENCES –**

* This application will be heavily used on phones while people are playing golf. It needs to very simple and easy to use as folks will be using it in between holes  
* I want an event to have a nice professional looking leaderboard to show live scores. Use TV broadcasts for inspiration  
* I’d like league organizers to be able to share a link to an event sign up that they can email to their players so they can click \-\> login \-\> sign up  
* Events should specify if players can pick their own teams or not. There needs to be an easy way to create teams.  
* Team names can be created. By default its a combination of the players names.  
* It should be able to calculate the payouts for an event (will provide algorithm later), but also they can be manually entered.  
* Some events will have closest to the pin or long drive competitions (optional). Need a separate entry fee for that, also would like to input the winner.  
* League organizers need an easy way to mark users has having paid their event fee. For me, im usually collecting cash on the driving range right before my tee time. I want this easy to manage on my phone.

**– FORMATS –**

For each of the formats (besides Up & Back), I want to be able to pick the tees for the hole. Sometimes we play all Blue, sometimes its blue but the par 3s are from the Golds. I like to switch it up. It’s not locked into the format.

1. **Team Up & Back**

X people per team (default 2 person teams). The score for the hole is the sum of all the players net scores. Start from the default tees (usually “Blue”). If the team total is net under par you move back a set of tees (i.e. from blue to black). If you the team is over par you move up (i.e. Blue to White). If you are net even you stay where you are at. You can also max out meaning if you are at the very front and you are over par you just stay the farthest front (same goes for moving back). The team needs to know where to tee off from before they start the hole.

The team scores is the sum of the net sums across all holes.

Each player gets their full handicap

2. **Vegas Scoring**

2 person teams. Each player records a net score for a hole. Lets say Player A is a 4 and player 2 is a 5\. If both scores are better than a double bogey you create a two-digit number starting with the lower number. So in this case the score would be 45\. However if one (or both) scores is a double bogey or worse, then the high number is used first. So in this case it was a Par 3, the 5 is a double bogey so the teams score is a 54\. Total these two-digit numbers up across all holes and that is the final score.

Each player gets their full handicap

3. **Vegas Up & Back**

2 person teams. Combine the vegas scoring format with the team up and back tee movement.

Each player gets their full handicap

4. **Ocean’s 6**  
   

Individual, nine hole format. You count 6 scores total. Take 1 and only 1 score from a Par 3\. Take 1 and only 1 score from a Par 5\. Then take 4 scores from Par 4s. The trick is you must decide you are keeping or discarding the score as soon as the current hole ends. So if I keep the first par 3, my next par 3 score doesn’t even matter. Same with the par 5\. I can close out my card before the 9th hole, no problem. Add up the scores from your kept holes and that is the total.

Each player gets their full handicap

5. **Best ball**  
   

Teams (x number). Standard golf best ball, just use the best net score from the team. Add them up, thats your team score.

Each player gets their full handicap

6. **Standard Stroke Play (net)**

Individual stroke play, total your net scores per hole

Each player gets their full handicap

7. **Scramble**

Teams (x number). Everyone hits, picks their favorite shot then plays next shot from there. Record 1 score per team. Add that score across all holes for total.

9 hole 2 player team playing handicap=(35%×lower player’s Course Handicap)+(15%×higher player’s Course Handicap)

9 hole 4 player team playing handicap=(25%×A)+(20%×B)+(15%×C)+(10%×D)

8. **Alternate Shot**

2 person teams. Alternate who takes a shot. Record 1 net score per hole. Add scores across all holes

Team Playing Handicap=50%×(Player A 9-hole Course Handicap+Player B 9-hole Course Handicap)

9. **High Ball**

2 person teams. Just like best ball except you keep the highest net score not the lowest.

Each player gets their full handicap
